html:
The Helvetic Republic was a state set up in Switzerland by revolutionary France in 1798, during the French Revolutionary Wars. It lasted until 1803.

French armies invaded in 1798 and ended the loose old Swiss Confederation, a league of self-governing cantons. In its place came a single central state on the French model, with one government, equal citizens and the cantons cut down to mere districts. It abolished the old subject territories and feudal dues.

Many Swiss hated it. It was French in origin, it took heavy levies, and in 1799 Switzerland became a battlefield for French, Austrian and Russian armies. Coups and civil strife followed. In 1803 Napoleon imposed the Act of Mediation, which brought back the cantons in a looser federation. The idea of equal rights stayed, and modern Switzerland took up some of it in 1848.
sum: The Helvetic Republic was a state set up in Switzerland by revolutionary France in 1798, during the French Revolutionary Wars. It lasted until 1803.
